name: ecg_ptbxl_benchmarking
description: Benchmark for automated ECG diagnosis using the PTB-XL dataset; measures models' ability to classify cardiac conditions from multi-lead ECG time-series data. Evaluates multi-label and multi-class ECG classification performance across a wide set of clinically relevant labels. Intended for assessing clinical-grade and research ECG classifiers on standard splits and metrics.
reputation: Widely used academic benchmark in the medical ML community for ECG classification with broad adoption in research papers and method comparisons.
